mapper.sql: transaction_id AS transactionId, business_type AS businessType, business_key AS businessKey, operation_type AS operationType, status, last_error AS lastError, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mq_transaction_record ( transaction_id, business_type, business_key, operation_type, status, last_error, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{transactionId}, #{businessType}, #{businessKey}, #{operationType}, 'PREPARED', #{lastError}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE mq_transaction_record SET status = 'COMMITTED', last_error = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE transaction_id = #{transactionId} AND status = 'PREPARED'
UPDATE mq_transaction_record SET status = 'ROLLED_BACK', last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE transaction_id = #{transactionId} AND status = 'PREPARED'
